desc.help: Lists the commands that are valid now, or explains one
desc.status: Shows the scenario: its plays, its pending decisions and the Director
desc.quota: Shows the quota of every profile
desc.cost: Shows the spending: tokens, real cost and caps
desc.executors: Lists the Executors and whether each is valid
desc.plays: Lists the open plays of the scenario
desc.logs: Shows the last events of the scenario
desc.doctor: Checks the daemon, the profiles and the Executors
desc.pause: Pauses the open plays of the scenario
desc.resume: Resumes the paused plays of the scenario
desc.cancel: Cancels the open plays of the scenario (asks for confirmation)
desc.stop: Stops the reply the Director is giving; the plays go on
desc.new: Opens a new chat scenario, or a project scenario with "new project <repo>"
desc.attach: Attaches a file to the scenario
desc.export: Exports the scenario with its plays and decisions
desc.model: Shows the model of the Director, or changes it
desc.effort: Shows the effort of the Director, or changes it
desc.director: Lists the Executors of the Director, or switches it (default: back to the default)
desc.profile: Lists the profiles and their state
desc.directives: Lists the orders in force for the scenario
desc.config: Shows a key of the configuration, or its sections
desc.direct: Opens a direct session with an Actor, outside the Director
desc.trajectory: Shows the trajectory of a play, or the diff of one of its demands

confirm.ask: /{{command}} asks for your confirmation before it runs. Send it again confirmed to go on.

error.unknown: There is no command /{{name}}. /help lists the ones that are valid now.
error.forbidden: /{{name}} changes things, and chat.slash_access is read_only.
error.clientOff: The commands of the client are off (chat.client_commands: off).
error.clientInTurn: The Director is in a turn: the commands of the client wait for it to finish.
error.clientNotStarted: The Director has not had its first turn yet: the command of the client would go inside the first prompt.
error.clientNoSession: The Director has no open session now (it sleeps or has not started).
error.noChannel: This daemon cannot talk to the Director: it runs no plays.

newProject.badRepo: Could not open a project on "{{repo}}": it is not a git repository the project can start from.

notAvailable.kind: scenarios of this type have no plays
notAvailable.noUnpausedPlay: every open play is already paused

error.noDirector: No Executor is set for the Director.
error.noDirectors: This daemon cannot switch the Director: it has no Director sessions.
error.noDirect: This daemon cannot hold direct sessions: it runs no plays.
error.noTrajectory: This daemon has no trajectory service.

trajectory.noPlay: The scenario has no play yet.

director.busy: The Director is in a turn.

cost.unknown: {{count}} turns have no known cost: the figures are a lower bound.

logs.empty: There are no events for this scenario yet.

doctor.store: {{status}} Store: the log is at event {{last}}.

stop.done: Stopped the reply of the Director.
stop.idle: The Director is not giving a reply.

director.pending: The Director is in a turn: the switch to {{what}} ({{source}}) waits for the turn to end.

form.live: The Director now runs {{what}} ({{source}}), changed in the open session.
form.new_session: The Director moved to {{what}} ({{source}}): a new session opened, with the role and the state summary in its first prompt.
form.baton: The Director goes on with {{what}} ({{source}}) in a new session: the client does not let the open one change.
form.stored: The Director will use {{what}} ({{source}}) when its session opens.
form.unchanged: The Director already ran {{what}} ({{source}}); nothing changed.

directives.empty: There is no order in force.

forwarded.client: Sent to the client of the Director.

direct.opened: Opened the direct session {{id}} with {{executor}} (workspace: {{workspace}}). Continue it in the Direct tab.
direct.confirm: The session would write in the folder of the scenario. Open it from the Direct tab to confirm.

trajectory.empty: The play {{play}} has no trajectory yet.
trajectory.diffHeader: Diff of the demand {{demand}} of the play {{play}}:
trajectory.diffEmpty: The demand {{demand}} has no changes against the branch of the play.

reason.no_vcs: this daemon has no version control
reason.no_attempt: the demand has no attempt yet
reason.no_branch: the branch of the attempt is gone
